prompt.text:
Implement a new immutable reading-list module. Export `BookInput`, `Book`, `AddBookResult`, and `addBook`. `BookInput` contains `title`, `author`, `publishedYear`, and `genre`; `Book` adds `id` and `ownerId`. `addBook(existing, ownerId, id, input)` returns either `{ ok: true, books, book }` or `{ ok: false, errors, books }`. Validate all fields together: ownerId, id, title, author, and genre must be non-blank after trimming; publishedYear must be an integer from 1450 through 2100 inclusive; and id must not already exist. Errors must appear in this order when applicable: `ownerId`, `id`, `title`, `author`, `publishedYear`, `genre`, `duplicateId`. On success, stored string fields are trimmed and the new book is appended. On failure, content and order are preserved. In both cases, returned books and their objects must be fresh copies; success must also return a separate copy as `book`, with no alias to the array entry. Do not mutate any input. Return a complete source file.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
